# `adt get`

Get details about a specific ABAP object

```bash
adt get [options] [command] <objectName>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument       | Description                 | Default |
| -------------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<objectName>` | ABAP object name to inspect |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON | `false` |

**Subcommands**

| Command           | Description                                                                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt get package` | Get details about a specific ABAP package                                                |
| `adt get badi`    | Get BAdI metadata; use --implementations on a definition to list classic implementations |

## `adt get package`

Get details about a specific ABAP package

```bash
adt get package [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description             | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | Package name to inspect |         |

**Options**

| Option              | Description                              | Default |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`            | Output as JSON                           | `false` |
| `--objects`         | List objects in the package              |         |
| `--no-sub-packages` | Exclude subpackages when listing objects |         |

## `adt get badi`

Get BAdI metadata; use --implementations on a definition to list classic implementations

```bash
adt get badi [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                                   | Default |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | BAdI definition, implementation, or ENHO name |         |

**Options**

| Option              | Description                                                                      | Default |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`            | Output as JSON                                                                   |         |
| `--implementations` | When reading a classic definition (SXSD/XD), include its SXCI/XI implementations |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
